name: Flexoki for Orca
description: Unofficial port of Flexoki, the inky color scheme for prose and code by Steph Ango (stephango.com/flexoki): Light and Dark app themes, matching syntax and terminal colors, and Flexoki Icons file icons (based on Symbols and Pierre Trees icons).
